AudioDuplicate.WindowTitle: GF Music Manager · Review audio warnings
AudioDuplicate.Heading: Review audio warnings
AudioDuplicate.Description: Review audio sources by warning type. Sources are included by default; exclude only what you do not need.
AudioDuplicate.Empty: There are no warnings of this type.
AudioDuplicate.Batch.Label: Batch actions:
AudioDuplicate.Batch.Prefer.ContentToolt: For every content-match group, include only the source from the highest-priority mod
AudioDuplicate.Batch.AdoptAll.ContentToo: Include every source in all content-match groups
AudioDuplicate.Batch.ExcludeAll.ContentT: Exclude every source in all content-match groups
AudioDuplicate.Batch.Prefer.SimilarToolt: For every similar-candidate group, include only the source from the highest-priority mod
AudioDuplicate.Batch.AdoptAll.SimilarToo: Include every source in all similar-candidate groups
AudioDuplicate.Batch.ExcludeAll.SimilarT: Exclude every source in all similar-candidate groups
AudioDuplicate.ApplyInstruction: Choose the sources to include. Select one source per path conflict; for content matches and similar candidates, decide per source or use the batch actions above.
AudioDuplicate.Page.PathConflict:
Multiple audio assets resolve to the same in-game path. The output mod cannot use the same path at the same time, so choose one source for each group.
Detection: normalized in-game audio path match
AudioDuplicate.Page.ContentMatch:
The in-game paths differ, but the audio file contents match. This is not an in-game path conflict, so multiple sources can be included as separate assets.
Detection: full-file SHA-256 match
Checked: included · Unchecked: excluded
AudioDuplicate.Page.Similar:
These sources may represent the same audio with differences such as volume, re-encoding, or leading and trailing silence. They are not excluded automatically; preview them and decide.
Detection: normalized mono-waveform feature comparison
Checked: included · Unchecked: excluded
